| GLM-5.2 | 14 | 34 | 75 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| GLM-5.3 | 1 | 1 | 10 | B300 |
| DeepSeek-V4 | 12 | 26 | 70 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 | 9 | 22 | 67 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.5 | 16 (was 17) | 51 (was 49) | 220 (was 219) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 5 | 24 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |
| Muse Spark Open | 6 | 9 | 64 (was 63) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |

**New: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash** (all on `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-minimax-m31-flash`, pinned by digest; DSpark speculative decoding)
- **GB300** ([InferenceX #4456](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4456), [#4465](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4465), [#4511](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4511), merged): TP4 c1–c32, TP4+EP4 c32, a batch-1 MSA-V1 MonoKernel Low-Latency point (`--monokernel-backend msa`), and HiCache points (TP4 c64, TP2 c32–c44, TP4+EP4 c64 / c128).
- **B300 / GB200 / B200** ([InferenceX #4492](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4492), [#4491](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4491), [#4490](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4490), verified by their `/use` runs): TP4 c1–c32 and HiCache points (TP4, and TP4+EP4 on GB200 / B200).
- **B300 TP2** ([InferenceX #4524](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4524), in progress): TP2 HiCache c32–c48.

- **Qwen3.5 FP8 H200 SGLang ([InferenceX #4455](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4455), in progress).** The c4–c48 points move to FA3 TP8/EP1 with HiCache.
- **Muse Spark Open B300 SGLang ([InferenceX #4417](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4417), in progress).** Rendered at its new head `5422503f`.
- **DeepSeek-V4 B300 ([InferenceX #4346](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4346)), Qwen3.5 GB300 ([InferenceX #4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333)).** #4346 is pinned to its newer `/use` run; #4333 is unchanged.

**From InferenceX `main`**
- Now verified on `main` (they were in progress in #46005): DeepSeek-V4-Pro GB300 Dynamo+SGLang ([InferenceX #4401](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4401)), GLM-5.2 GB200 Dynamo+SGLang ([InferenceX #4398](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4398)), Muse Spark Open B200 / GB300 ([InferenceX #4400](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4400), [#4404](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4404)).
- Image updates: GLM-5.2 GB300 Dynamo+SGLang agg ([InferenceX #4449](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4449)), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 SGLang ([InferenceX #4448](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4448)), Muse Spark Open GB200 ([InferenceX #4430](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4430)), Qwen3.5 FP8 B200 SGLang ([InferenceX #4396](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4396), `v0.5.22-cu130`).

**Linker config flag (#46388).** #46388 renamed `--hicache-storage-backend-extra-config` to `--unified-cache-external-linker-config` in the generated data. This sync shows the flag as SemiAnalysis launched it: the submission recipes use `--hicache-storage-backend-extra-config`, and every submission image predates `--unified-cache-external-linker-config` (added to `main` on 2026-10-25), so the renamed commands would not parse in the images shown. Current SGLang still accepts the old flag (deprecated for external linkers). `_agentx.jsx` keeps #46388's spelling in `LINKER_FLAGS` and adds the old one, so the KV-tier switch strips either.

**Flag rules added**
- Keep (serving): `--enable-nvidia-megakernel`, `SGLANG_NVIDIA_MEGAKERNEL_SLOTS`, `SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC`, `--startup-weight-load-mode` ([InferenceX #4434](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4434)); `--monokernel-backend`, `FMHA_SM100_ALLOW_JIT`, `ALLOW_JIT`, `SGLANG_FORCE_COARSE_WAR_BARRIER` (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash).
- Remove: `--enable-metrics-for-all-schedulers` (metrics only, like `--enable-metrics`); `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_GREEDY` (part of synthetic acceptance, read only with `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN`; disclosed with it).

## Validation

- Every page in a headless browser (`mint dev`, Mintlify as in CI). Every hardware / checkpoint / deployment / concurrency / KV tier / router combination renders exactly the decoded commands: 3,102 command sets, 0 mismatches, 0 unseen, no browser errors. Every tab was clicked, and every "Copy link" URL was reopened. The section links from the Deployment panels and the copy buttons were also checked.
- The component's own decoder reproduces every generated plan (3,102 router × KV-tier variants). Every KV flag exists in its image's SGLang commit (239 image × flag pairs). The round-trip / leak check reports 0 problems.
- **Arg-parse in the submission images:** all 589 commands that changed since the last validated round parse with each image's own SGLang / Dynamo parsers (9 images, including `dev-minimax-m31-flash` for every MiniMax-M3.1-Flash command and its derived Dynamo variant; every image's amd64 and arm64 builds share one SGLang commit).
- `node scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`, `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects`, `mint validate` and `pre-commit run --all-files` (in `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13`) pass.

+## Agentic Long-Context Deployment
+
+Agentic workloads, such as coding agents and other multi-turn, tool-using assistants, send long prompts whose prefixes grow and repeat from turn to turn. Serving them well depends on reusing the KV cache across turns, offloading it beyond GPU memory, and keeping each session on the workers that already hold its prefix. This section gives complete launch commands for such deployments, each benchmarked in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) and linked to the run that measured it.
